The US proposed new tariffs of up to 20% on 14 economies including China, the EU, Japan and South Korea on 25 November; China said it reserves the right to respond.
Leaked Rosstat data shows at least 490,000 Russian soldiers dead by late September, Meduza and Mediazona found; counting the missing, they estimate more than 700,000.
The US told its citizens to leave Iran immediately, warning that hostilities could escalate rapidly; Trump said the war is funded through the end of January.
Kim Jong Un called for North Korea's tactical nuclear weapons to be deployed across multiple domains and said bomb-material production is expanding.
Poland will create a no-fly zone along its border with Ukraine; Trump and NATO's Rutte urged Russia not to widen the war.
Ukraine's General Staff says drones damaged five Russian jets at Savasleyka airbase; Russian missiles hit Kharkiv and a Kyiv shopping centre.
A US consortium signed a deal for sanctioned Lukoil's foreign assets, pending OFAC approval; the Houthis claim strikes on Saudi ports and Riyadh.
